title: One Key To Start Retrofitting Two-way Anti-theft Remote Control
body_html:
Product information:

Material: ABS.
Alarm mode: sound and vibration
Alarm range: 1500 meters
Power supply voltage: 12 (V)
Operating temperature: -20 ~ 60 (℃)
Type: Bidirectional


Features:

This product is suitable for 12V cars, the main circuit part adopts Italian and French original chip, brand relay, solid capacitor, stable performance, reliable quality. Remote control chip for the original American MICROCHIP: bidirectional remote control chip, using superheterodyne RADIO frequency technology, effective transmission distance up to 1500 meters!


Packing list:

Automobile two-way main engine *1
Automobile bidirectional starter wiring *1
Six-tone speaker (12V-30W) *1
Automobile two-way manual (English 145*140mm) *1
